menu.definedIn: Defined in <file /> — change it in git

protected.label: Why you break the protection of {{environment}}
protected.text: {{environment}} is protected: only runs write there. Doing this by hand needs the right to manage the environment and is recorded in the audit log.

drop.title: Drop {{table}}?
drop.text: It leaves the catalog with its grants, row filters and column masks. You can restore it from Dropped during the undo period (7 days unless your operator changed it).
drop.purge: Delete the files now: the table cannot be restored
drop.artifactText: This cannot be undone: every version's files are deleted.

rebuild.title: Rebuild {{table}} from git?
rebuild.text: It drops the table, which you can restore like any drop, and queues a run of the asset that builds it.
rebuild.reason: Why it is rebuilt (recorded in the audit log)
rebuild.protected: {{environment}} is protected: only runs write there. Your reason is also sent as the reason you break its protection, which needs the right to manage the environment.
rebuild.done: Dropped {{table}} and queued run {{run}} of {{repository}}, which builds it again from {{path}}.

undrop.title: Restore {{table}}
undrop.text: The table comes back with its data as it was when it was dropped.
undrop.restoreAsHelp: The table comes back under this name. Choose one that no table in {{namespace}} has.
